svg.text: CUT THROUGH THE UPPER DRAWERS · SCALE 1:10 · THE PARTITION AT THE TOP, THE BED BELOW · TOP AND PLINTH DASHED

g.text: 2313 — ONE STRAIGHT FRONT, TIP TO TIP
7'-7⅛" — ONE STRAIGHT FRONT, TIP TO TIP

svg.text: ▼ THE FOOT OF THE BED, 2 ft 6⅜ in FROM THE FRONTS — 1 ft 4⅝ in WITH A DRAWER OUT
ENDS CURVE TO THE BED: 5 BLOCKS ON R 660, 65°
IT READS THROUGH THE GLASS FROM THE DESK
OUTER DRAWERS CUT TO THE CURVE
THE ONLY BAY DEEP ENOUGH FOR IT
SEEN FROM THE BED · SCALE 1:10 · THE GLASS BROKEN OFF ABOVE
SONY BAR 6 SUB ON ITS SIDE
THE END STOPS AT THE GLASS'S TIP
DETAIL 1 · THE END AT THE CURVE
THE GLASS CURVES TO THE BED
THE BOX'S BACK CUT TO THE CURVE
IT RUNS STRAIGHT OUT, SHORTER RUNNERS
The partition's ends curve towards the bed, a proper curve — 5 blocks
at each end on a 660 radius, 65°, coming 1 ft 3 in forward (owner, 29 Oct).
The drawers fill the space between the two curves: one straight front
from tip to tip, six bays, two drawers in each. The outer drawers' boxes
are cut at the back to the curve, so every drawer runs straight out.
One bay open for the subwoofer — the only one deep enough for it.
TELL ME IF ANY OF THESE IS WRONG
Height 1 ft 5¾ in and depth 1 ft 3¾ in in the middle, as before.
The 9292 burl, polished darker than the room (owner, 7 Oct),
the grain running on across all six bays.
The slim brass bar on every drawer.
Every edge eased 5 mm; the top a full bullnose.
The right-hand cabinet door is gone: drawers, as asked.
Fronts: eased edges as drawn, or rounder —
each front a small pill of its own?
Pulls: the brass bar, or push-to-open with none.
The curve: Eco Outdoor to confirm R 660 for this block —
joints 21 mm on the bed side, 0 on the desk side.

g.text: Plan · Front · Section A–A · End at the curve
3 — the partition's ends curve 15 in to the bed; the drawers fill the space between the curves (owner, 29 Oct)
